crawl: Chrome live crawl, same-origin fetch, cache: no-store, sequential per URL, on 2026-10-26 Vietnam time (a scan for 26 Oct, three days after the 23 Oct crawl; no 24 or 25 Oct scan exists).
method: TTFB measured with performance.now() around a sequential fetch of each URL with a 15 s abort. Words counted on a body clone with script/style/noscript/template removed. Schema blocks counted as application/ld+json elements, @type walked through @graph. Internal links are unique same-origin paths per page. MISSING-ALT RULE (in force since 2 Oct 2026): only visible outside
score_rationale: Health 97 -> 97 (raw 96.5 -> 96.5; weights .25/.25/.20/.15/.15). Three-day step from 23 Oct (no 24 or 25 Oct scan). PERFORMANCE holds at 98: 117 of 118 pages are under one second; site mean TTFB 314.4 ms (310.4 on 23 Oct), median 249 ms (256). One page, /articles/3d-rendering-adelaide, read 1,455 ms in the sequential pass (the only page in the 1-3 s band) but four cache-busted re-reads of the same URL gave 440, 595, 411 and 593 ms, so it is treated as a transient spike, not a regression; the ceiling therefore reads 774 -> 1,455 ms. CRAWLABILITY holds at 98: 118/118 return 200, 0 orphans; total distinct internal links fall 2,799 -> 2,705 (22.92 per page; the extra template link seen on 23 Oct is gone again, as on 22 Oct) and 3 articles stay linked only from the hub. ON-PAGE holds at 93: /articles/3d-rendering-company-melbourne is still cross-canonical (self canonical 117/118). STRUCTURED DATA holds at 98 (FAQPage 95/95, 407 blocks). CONTENT holds at 93: no new article since 24 Sep (32 days); words unchanged at 243,401.

roadmap: P0 - publish a new article. Thirty-two calendar days without one keeps Content at 93 and gives Google no freshness signal.

P0 - resolve /articles/3d-rendering-company-melbourne: it serves the same 3,225-word body as /articles/3d-rendering-melbourne-pre-construction-planning and declares that page as canonical, yet it is still in the sitemap and hub; 301 it to the target and remove it from the sitemap, or restore distinct content with a self canonical.
P1 - keep the template link: total internal links are down to 2,705 (22.92 per page) from 2,799; 3 articles are linked only from the hub.
P1 - performance: 117 of 118 pages under 1 s, mean 314 ms; /articles/3d-rendering-adelaide read 1,455 ms once (re-reads 411-595 ms) - watch it; held at 98.
P1 - review the Ahrefs result: Health 99%, 5 internal URLs with errors; open the full list and fix the errors first.
